data.name: Tammiel
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Tammiel means 'God is my consolation.' This biblical name comes from the Hebrew words 'etam' (my God) and 'yachal' (comfort). It was an ancient name for a high priest or angel. In Christian tradition, Tammiel is also associated with the archangel Raphael.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes comfort and consolation from God

in_hebrew.name: תַּמִּיאֵל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: תַּמִּיאֵל הוא שם עברי שמשמעו אלוהים סופר או מוכר, והוא מורכב מהמילים תַּם שפירושו תם או שלם, ואלוהים, השם העברי לאלוהים

in_greek.name: Θαμμιήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Θαμμιήλ έχει εβραϊκή προέλευση και σημαίνει ο Θεός είναι τέλειος, και αποτελείται από τις λέξεις θαμ, που σημαίνει τέλειος, καιμιήλ, που σημαίνει Θεός

in_latin.name: Thammihel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Thammihel habet originem hebraicam et significat Deus est perfectus, et constat ex verbis thamm, quod significat perfectus, et hel, quod significat Deus

As a cultural name, Tammiel has an air of reverence and faith, a name that calls to mind the comforting presence of the divine.

historical_references.context: In the Middle Ages, Tammiel was used as a variant of Tammy, which was a feminine form of Thomas.
